Chapter 1178: Chapter 3 Fusion of the Source Object (Request Subscription)

The myriad rules of the Great Dao, with time and space as their sovereign, as for the Chaos Rule?

When the world was created, the Chaos Rule evolved into countless rules of the Great Dao, not among them.

As a thirteen-tier weapon, the small cauldron had long surpassed its role as a mere weapon, containing within it a vast world where numerous rules of the Great Dao operate.

The operations of these rules of the Great Dao are the interpretation of the rule of the Great Dao by the owner of this small cauldron—

which is, that time life, distinct from the rules of the Great Dao of the Chaos Void.

Especially the intertwining method of time and space within it, to Lin Yuan, it was an unprecedented inspiration.

"So, that’s how it is."

The time and space in Lin Yuan’s eyes suddenly became simple and orderly, as if the originally chaotic threads had been completely combed through.

[Your comprehension is extraordinary, watching the operation of world rules sharply enhances your perception of the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule...]

...

A vast amount of insights into time and space gathered, Lin Yuan’s eyes shone brightly, as if seeing through the essence of countless time-spaces in the Chaos Void.

"The Ninth Realm of Time-space, this is the Ninth Realm of Time-space."

Lin Yuan was in high spirits; his understanding of time and space had originally reached the peak of the Eighth Realm.

Now, through the touch of time and space operations within the vast world of the small cauldron, he naturally crossed into the Ninth Realm of Time-space.

In the Chaos Void, those Chaos Great Saints, their understanding and insight into time and space typically remain at the Eighth Realm.

As for the Ninth Realm? That is the exclusive domain of extraordinary Great Saints, a few of whom, or those who are simply invincible Great Saints dominating an era, will have their understanding of time and space reaching the peak of the Ninth Realm.

"No wonder His Majesty Xuanhuang, during his final times, seemed to have an insight into time and space that vaguely surpassed the Ninth Realm..."

Lin Yuan thought about the way Xuanhuang Mausoleum merged into time and space, a method so extraordinary in its use of time and space.

At least, at that time, Lin Yuan couldn’t perceive it at all.

In hindsight, it should be the gains Xuanhuang reaped after contemplating this small cauldron.

Lin Yuan was able to obtain great insights right at the beginning of his meditation, pushing his understanding of time and space to the Ninth Realm.

Xuanhuang, being such an invincible Great Saint, even if his perception wasn’t as good as Lin Yuan’s, would have gained something with more meditation.

And achieving the pinnacle of the Ninth Realm of Time-space, every step forward was as hard as climbing to heaven, yet the mastery of time and space would also leap dramatically.

Lin Yuan speculated that Xuanhuang’s final insight into time and space had already halfway stepped out of the Ninth Realm.

"It’s a pity that no matter how high the insight into time and space, it doesn’t help with breaking through time loops, and even due to proficiency in time and space understanding, the trials faced within time loops are unrelated to time and space."

Lin Yuan mused to himself, which was one of the reasons why Xuanhuang did not continue contemplating the small cauldron.

If he could cross into the Thirteen-tier, life’s magnitude would dramatically enhance, and the insight into time and space would naturally rise above the Ninth Realm.

"However, I don’t need to consider these now."

Lin Yuan shook his head slightly; one reason why Xuanhuang hurriedly rushed to the Thirteen-tier at that time was that the small cauldron was almost unbearable.

But now?

After being suppressed by Xuanhuang for over three thousand Cosmic Eras, this small cauldron won’t break free within the next hundred Cosmic Eras.

And a hundred Cosmic Eras?

From Lin Yuan’s birth till now, counting the time spent traversing, it was merely about ten thousand years, if a Cosmic Era was an endless ocean.

Then, the years Lin Yuan had experienced were merely a droplet within it, or even a billionth of a droplet.

From the Mastery Realm to the perfect Chaos Realm, Xuanhuang’s expectation for Lin Yuan was to achieve this within a hundred Cosmic Eras, under the precondition of not knowing Lin Yuan’s actual cultivation time.

...

Lin Yuan continued to comprehend the small cauldron.

In a daze, Lin Yuan seemed to vaguely see a towering blurry figure, a bald head, in front of him were more than ten weapons hovering, among which was a small cauldron.

The small cauldron floated, with endless waves of force spreading in all directions, wiping out everything within the range of tens of thousands, hundreds of thousands, millions of Void Domains under its power.

"That must be the true owner of the small cauldron, the mark left by the Thirteen-tier Temporal Life."

Lin Yuan understood, naturally did not dare to touch, for fear of drawing the attention of the Thirteen-tier Temporal Life.

In fact, the reason why this Thirteen-tier Temporal Life had not taken back the small cauldron might not be due to forgetfulness, but because the time concept of a Thirteen-tier life is fundamentally different from that of a Twelfth-tier life.

Thirty million Cosmic Eras? Three hundred million Cosmic Eras? Possibly, in the eyes of a Thirteen-tier Temporal Life, it is just a blink of an eye.

Thirteen-tier Temporal Lives can see through many future timelines; for them, the small cauldron would only be recalled when needed at some future time.

As for what the small cauldron would experience during this period, whose hands it might fall into, that time life wouldn’t care much.

"Sky Void Tripod?"

During his deep insight into the small cauldron, Lin Yuan learned its name.

Sky Void Tripod.

This was also a mark left inside the small cauldron, easily comprehended with a little insight.

"Is this the Thirteen-tier Temporal Life?"

Lin Yuan’s mind was quite complicated.

Merely the residual power naturally emitted from a Thirteen-tier weapon could easily wipe out millions of Void Domains.

If that Thirteen-tier Temporal Life were to strike with full force, would it not be able to destroy half the Chaos Void?

This was just in terms of sheer power; for Thirteen-tier life, the most crucial point was the mastery of future timelines.
